subject: Amendment Required: Draft Bill of Lading Discrepancies
body:
Dear Partner,

Please review the Shipping Instruction, which serves as the authoritative reference for this shipment.
We have found discrepancies in the draft Bill of Lading that must be amended to match the Shipping Instruction.
The Consignee is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, but appears as UAB NOVAKOPA in the draft Bill of Lading.
The Notify Party is listed as EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC in the Shipping Instruction, but appears as UAB NOVAKOPA in the draft Bill of Lading.
Please update the draft Bill of Lading accordingly and provide the revised version at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
